sections.changelog:
Added

  • Initial scaffold.
  • WooCommerce guard: admin notice and early exit when WooCommerce is not active.
  • Settings model: defaults, group picking and reading of the WooCommerce stock display format.
  • Settings API registration with range validation (reversed and overlapping ranges are rejected).
  • Settings page on the MVweb Admin UI Kit: group ranges, wording, colours, output template and weight toggle.
  • Status block telling the admin what the current WooCommerce stock display format means for the plugin.
  • Front-end replacement through the `woocommerce_get_availability` filter, covering simple products and variations.
  • Label styles on CSS variables, colours printed inline from the settings.
  • Help tab: quick start, how it works and four FAQ entries.
  • Russian translation (62 strings).

Fixed

  • Tab navigation on the settings page: the script now matches the UI Kit markup.
  • Build script paths pointed at files left over from another plugin.
  • Settings notices were registered under a slug the page never rendered, so neither validation errors nor the "Settings saved" notice appeared.
  • An empty colour field silently stored an empty string instead of falling back to the group default.
  • An unknown value of the WooCommerce stock display format is now treated as "no quantity printed", matching wc_format_stock_for_display().
  • A template with a lone percent sign or an extra specifier made sprintf() throw on every product page render. Such a template is now rejected on save, and the front end falls back to the bare label instead of taking the page down.
  • Values read from the option on the front end are sanitized again, guarded by is_scalar(): an option written straight into the database could otherwise print "Array" as the label, or take the product page down when it held an object.
